subject: Re: Subprocessor change — conditional consent & DPA redlines

From: Emma Doyle <emma.doyle@echosys.io>

Subject: Notice: new subprocessor + DPA redline submission

Hi Lauren —

Per our contract (Order Form #ECH-4372), we have added a new analytics subprocessor (Glacier Insights) to support model usage telemetry. We need Redwood to confirm flow-down acceptance or provide any conditional requirements by EOD 2026-05-12.

Attached: Echosys_subproc_change_notice_v3.pdf and our proposed DPA redline (Echosys_DPA_redline_20260508.docx). The legal team flagged two practical items we expect you to accept or counter:
- Security control mapping for Glacier Insights (SOC2 + encryption-in-transit).
- Written confirmation that data retention limits for telemetry are consistent with the DPA.

Can you confirm next steps and point us to the right Redwood contact for approvals?

Thanks,
Emma Doyle
Legal Ops — Echosys

Attachment stubs: Echosys_subproc_change_notice_v3.pdf (1 page notice), Echosys_DPA_redline_20260508.docx (redline)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Doyle <emma.doyle@echosys.io>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor + DPA redline submission

Thanks — I reviewed the Echosys redline and Glacier Insights onboarding packet. Summary of material points (high level):
- Glacier claims SOC2 Type II in-scope controls and TLS1.2+ for all ingestion endpoints. They provided a SOC2 bridge letter dated 2026-03-01 (PDF attached to my internal case).
- Echosys redline requests a change to Section 4.2 (subprocessor disclosure) to require prior written consent for any subcontracting change. Our standard MSA allows notice + cure rights, not prior consent for every add.
- Retention: Echosys wants contract-level retention capped at 30 days for telemetry. Our product telemetry pipeline retains aggregated metrics by default for 90 days; per-customer retention requests can be configured but may increase unit costs.

Proposal for reply to Echosys: conditional approval of Glacier Insights subject to (1) production of SOC2 bridge + audit contact, (2) acceptance of scoped retention exception: we can offer a 30-day raw telemetry retention for Echosys at an addendum price + fielding an SLA for deletion notifications, and (3) limited change-notice (we’ll provide 30 days' notice and reasonable opportunity to object for future subs).

Rishi — can you confirm whether ops can implement the 30-day retention slice and whether it will materially affect their telemetry features? If yes, I’ll draft the language to propose to Echosys.

Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: internal SOC2 bridge evidence (internal case #9462)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Doyle <emma.doyle@echosys.io>
Date: 2026-05-11T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor + DPA redline submission

Marissa — quick operational check. Short answer: yes, we can configure a 30-day raw telemetry retention for Echosys as a per-customer setting. Impact notes:
- There is a small engineering queue to apply the retention flag and schedule deletion jobs (estimated 3 business days once change ticket is approved).
- Some diagnostic features rely on a 90-day rolling window; we can scope this to exclude aggregated insights (aggregates retained 90 days by default) while ensuring raw event logs for Echosys are deleted at 30 days.
- There will be a marginal storage cost offset; recommend offering the 30-day retention as a paid addendum or include it as a one-time implementation fee.

If legal is comfortable with conditional approval language, we can accept and commit to the implementation timeline of 3 business days post-signature.

Rishi Malhotra
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference

Note: internal ticket REF-2317 will track implementation once approval given.

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Doyle <emma.doyle@echosys.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@echosys.io
Date: 2026-05-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor + DPA redline submission

Emma —

Appreciate the patience. Redwood can conditionally approve Glacier Insights as a subprocessor. Summary of our response and proposed contract language (high level):
- Conditional approval: Glacier Insights approved subject to delivery of SOC2 evidence (bridge letter + audit contact) within 10 business days.
- Retention: We can implement a 30-day raw-event telemetry retention for Echosys. Implementation will occur within 3 business days following executed addendum; we propose an implementation fee of $4,000 or inclusion in the order form at a 6% ARR uplift.
- Change notices: We cannot agree to prior written consent for every subcontractor addition. Instead we will commit to 30 days' notice for future subprocessor additions and to provide the same evidence package (controls + contact) on request.
- DPA redlines: we accept the retention caps above and will propose a concise addendum to Section 4.2 and Section 7.1 (data retention) to reflect the technical commitments above. Redlines brought back to you via DocuSign link once legal and procurement sign off.

Next steps: Marissa will send the proposed addendum language for redline by EOD 2026-05-13. Rishi will prepare the REF-2317 ticket and schedule the implementation slot. Please confirm that the pricing approach (implementation fee OR 6% ARR uplift) is acceptable so we can include it in the addendum.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
